note: Referral partner registry — one entry per co-branded landing page at slacapital.ai/<slug>/. Run scripts/generate-partner-pages.mjs after editing. Pages are noindex (shared directly with partner audiences, not for SEO). Leads submit through /api/lead-submit with source 'referral-<slug>' so the inbox subject line identifies the partner; the full-app link carries ?ref=<slug> for future portal-side tracking. Partner logos are self-hosted under /assets/partners/ (never hotlink).

partners.name: Easy Button Real Estate
partners.heroLine: Easy Button clients get the easy button for financing, too.
partners.lede: SLA Capital is the preferred lending partner of Easy Button Real Estate. If you're building your investing business with Easy Button, your deals get partner-priority treatment here — special approvals, a dedicated loan officer, and the fastest closings in private lending.

perks.title: Partner-priority approvals
perks.body: Easy Button files go to the front of the underwriting queue. Special approval consideration on deals that need a human look instead of a rubber stamp.

perks.title: A dedicated loan officer
perks.body: One point of contact who knows the Easy Button playbook — not a call center. Your LO sees your deal the way you do.

perks.title: The full investor menu
perks.body: DSCR rentals from 5.95% with 3-month cash-out seasoning, Fix & Flip from 9.5% at up to 92.5% LTC with 72-hour closings, and New Construction from 10% at 85% LTC.

perks.title: No bait-and-switch, ever
perks.body: The rate you're quoted is the rate you close at. No application fees, no appraisal fees, no junk. That's the whole brand.
